description.en: What hurts and how to say it at a British GP's surgery: from the appointment at the desk to the prescription for the chemist's. Granny Maggie says goodbye with 'Get well soon, love!'
description.sl: Kaj te boli in kako to poveš v britanski ambulanti osebnega zdravnika: od naročila na okencu do recepta za lekarno. Babica Maggie ob slovesu reče: »Get well soon, love!«
description.it: Che cosa ti fa male e come dirlo dal medico di famiglia in Gran Bretagna: dall'appuntamento all'accettazione alla ricetta per la farmacia. Nonna Maggie ti saluta con «Get well soon, love!»
description.de: Was wehtut und wie man es beim britischen Hausarzt sagt: vom Termin am Empfang bis zum Rezept für die Apotheke. Oma Maggie verabschiedet dich mit „Get well soon, love!“

review: de, sl, en, it: machine-written, not reviewed by a native speaker

words.example_en: I'm going to the doctor's today.
words.note: The doctor's: the doctor's practice. You call them Doctor and the surname, or just Doctor.
words.note_sl: The doctor's: zdravnikova ambulanta. Ogovoriš ga z Doctor in priimkom ali samo Doctor.
words.note_it: The doctor's: lo studio del medico. Ti rivolgi dicendo Doctor e il cognome, o solo Doctor.
words.note_de: The doctor's: die Arztpraxis. Man sagt Doctor und den Nachnamen oder nur Doctor.

words.example_sl: Moj osebni zdravnik je v Keswicku.
words.example_it: Il mio medico di famiglia è a Keswick.
words.note: General practitioner: the family doctor. You see your GP first; they send you on to hospital if you need it.
words.note_sl: General practitioner: družinski (osebni) zdravnik. Najprej greš k njemu; po potrebi te napoti v bolnišnico.
words.note_it: General practitioner: il medico di famiglia. Prima vai da lui; se serve, ti manda in ospedale.
words.note_de: General practitioner: der Hausarzt. Zuerst gehst du zu ihm; wenn nötig, schickt er dich ins Krankenhaus.

words.note: British: the doctor's practice. Surgery is also an operation in hospital.
words.note_sl: Britansko: zdravnikova ambulanta. Surgery je tudi operacija v bolnišnici.
words.note_it: Britannico: lo studio del medico. Surgery è anche un intervento chirurgico in ospedale.
words.note_de: Britisch: die Arztpraxis. Surgery ist auch eine Operation im Krankenhaus.

words.example_en: The receptionist says: take a seat, please.
words.example_it: La receptionist dice: si accomodi, prego.
words.example_de: Die Sprechstundenhilfe sagt: Nehmen Sie bitte Platz.
words.note: At a GP's surgery the receptionist books your appointments, on the phone or at the desk.
words.note_sl: V ambulanti osebnega zdravnika te receptor ali receptorka naroči, po telefonu ali na okencu.
words.note_it: Dal medico di famiglia la receptionist ti fissa gli appuntamenti, al telefono o allo sportello.
words.note_de: Beim Hausarzt vergibt die Sprechstundenhilfe die Termine, am Telefon oder am Empfang.

words.example_en: I've got an appointment at ten.
words.example_de: Ich habe um zehn einen Termin.
words.note: Make or book an appointment: get a time to see the doctor.
words.note_sl: Make (book) an appointment: naročiti se pri zdravniku.
words.note_it: Make (book) an appointment: prendere un appuntamento.
words.note_de: Make (book) an appointment: einen Termin ausmachen.

words.example_en: My stomach hurts: too much sticky toffee pudding!
words.example_sl: Želodec me boli: preveč sticky toffee pudinga!
words.example_it: Mi fa male lo stomaco: troppo sticky toffee pudding!
words.example_de: Mir tut der Magen weh: zu viel Sticky Toffee Pudding!
words.note: The ch is said like k. Children say tummy.
words.note_sl: Ch se izgovori kot k. Otroci rečejo tummy.
words.note_it: Il ch si pronuncia come k. I bambini dicono tummy.
words.note_de: Das ch spricht man wie k. Kinder sagen tummy.

words.example_en: My back hurts after the gardening.
words.example_sl: Po delu na vrtu me boli hrbet.
words.example_it: Dopo il lavoro in giardino mi fa male la schiena.
words.example_de: Nach der Gartenarbeit tut mir der Rücken weh.
words.note: Back is also a direction: come back, at the back.
words.note_sl: Back je tudi smer: come back (vrni se), at the back (zadaj).
words.note_it: Back indica anche una direzione: come back (torna), at the back (dietro).
words.note_de: Back ist auch eine Richtung: come back (komm zurück), at the back (hinten).

words.note: British: I've got a temperature means I've got a fever.
words.note_sl: Britansko: I've got a temperature pomeni, da imaš vročino.
words.note_it: Britannico: I've got a temperature vuol dire che hai la febbre.
words.note_de: Britisch: I've got a temperature heißt, dass du Fieber hast.

words.example_en: I've had a cough for three days.
words.example_it: Ho la tosse da tre giorni.
words.example_de: Ich habe seit drei Tagen Husten.
words.note: Say KOFF. It's a verb too: to cough.
words.note_sl: Izgovori »kof«. Je tudi glagol: to cough (kašljati).
words.note_it: Si pronuncia «coff». È anche un verbo: to cough (tossire).
words.note_de: Man sagt »koff«. Es ist auch ein Verb: to cough (husten).

words.example_en: I think I've got a cold.
words.note: Always with a: I've got a cold. Catch a cold: get one.
words.note_sl: Vedno z a: I've got a cold. Catch a cold: prehladiti se.
words.note_it: Sempre con a: I've got a cold. Catch a cold: prendere il raffreddore.
words.note_de: Immer mit a: I've got a cold. Catch a cold: sich erkälten.

words.note: Sore: it hurts. The throat: inside your neck. With a: I've got a sore throat.
words.note_sl: Sore: boleč. The throat: grlo. Z a: I've got a sore throat.
words.note_it: Sore: che fa male. The throat: la gola. Con a: I've got a sore throat.
words.note_de: Sore: wund, schmerzend. The throat: der Hals innen. Mit a: I've got a sore throat.

words.note: Head + ache (a pain); the ch is said like k. With a: I've got a headache.
words.note_sl: Head (glava) + ache (bolečina); ch se izgovori kot k. Z a: I've got a headache.
words.note_it: Head (testa) + ache (dolore); il ch si pronuncia come k. Con a: I've got a headache.
words.note_de: Head (Kopf) + ache (Schmerz); das ch spricht man wie k. Mit a: I've got a headache.

words.note: The doctor asks: Where does it hurt? In the past it stays the same: it hurt.
words.note_sl: Zdravnik vpraša: Where does it hurt? (Kje vas boli?) V pretekliku ostane enako: it hurt.
words.note_it: Il medico chiede: Where does it hurt? (Dove le fa male?) Al passato resta uguale: it hurt.
words.note_de: Der Arzt fragt: Where does it hurt? (Wo tut es weh?) In der Vergangenheit bleibt es gleich: it hurt.

words.example_en: I'm ill, so I'm staying in bed.
words.example_de: Ich bin krank, also bleibe ich im Bett.
words.note: British: I'm ill. I feel sick means you might throw up.
words.note_sl: Britansko: I'm ill ({m:bolan|f:bolna} sem). I feel sick pa pomeni, da ti je slabo.
words.note_it: In britannico: I'm ill (sono {m:malato|f:malata}). I feel sick vuol dire invece che hai la nausea.
words.note_de: Britisch: I'm ill (ich bin krank). I feel sick heißt dagegen: Mir ist übel.

words.example_en: Take two tablets three times a day.
words.example_sl: Jemljite dve tableti trikrat na dan.
words.example_it: Prenda due compresse tre volte al giorno.
words.example_de: Nehmen Sie dreimal am Tag zwei Tabletten.
words.note: Also: pills. A tablet is a small computer, too.
words.note_sl: Tudi: pills. Tablet je tudi tablični računalnik.
words.note_it: Anche: pills. Tablet è anche il tablet, il computer.
words.note_de: Auch: pills. Tablet ist auch ein Tablet-Computer.

words.example_en: Take this prescription to the chemist's.
words.example_de: Bringen Sie dieses Rezept in die Apotheke.
words.note: Careful: a recipe is for cooking; a prescription is for medicine.
words.note_sl: Pazi: recept za kuhanje je recipe, za zdravila prescription.
words.note_it: Attenzione: la ricetta di cucina è recipe, quella per le medicine prescription.
words.note_de: Vorsicht: ein Kochrezept ist recipe, ein Rezept für Medikamente prescription.

words.example_en: The chemist's is next to the surgery.
words.example_de: Die Apotheke ist neben der Praxis.
words.note: British: the chemist's is the shop, the chemist the person. Also: the pharmacy.
words.note_sl: Britansko: the chemist's je lekarna, the chemist lekarnar. Tudi: the pharmacy.
words.note_it: Britannico: the chemist's è la farmacia, the chemist il farmacista. Anche: the pharmacy.
words.note_de: Britisch: the chemist's ist die Apotheke, the chemist der Apotheker. Auch: the pharmacy.

words.note: On cards too. Warmer: Feel better soon, love.
words.note_sl: Tudi na voščilnicah. Topleje: Feel better soon, love.
words.note_it: Anche sui biglietti. Più affettuoso: Feel better soon, love.
words.note_de: Auch auf Karten. Herzlicher: Feel better soon, love.
